heading: Glen Waverley Man Rockets to Oz Lotto Glory
description: A Glen Waverley man won the Oz Lotto jackpot, becoming an overnight millionaire. Read about his incredible win and future plans
author: Lotto Express Marketing
body_html:
A Glen Waverley man’s life has been catapulted into the realm of multi-millionaires overnight with a $15 million Oz Lotto jackpot win. The man, who held one of two division one winning entries in Oz Lotto draw 1594, on Tuesday, September 3, 2024, struggled to contain his emotions as he processed the life-changing news.

The Victorian winner purchased his ticket at Seraglio Lotto, located in South Melbourne Central. A second $15 million division one winning entry went to a lucky player in New South Wales.

“I’m stunned,” the winner said reflecting on the moment. “I can’t believe this has happened. I’m crying. It’s so overwhelming. I woke up and scanned the ticket online. It was all I could think about!”

He added with a laugh, “I don’t know what to do next—maybe hire a bodyguard!”

Despite the overwhelming excitement, the winner decided to keep his routine intact. He headed to work the morning after discovering the win, using the distraction to help him absorb the magnitude of his newfound fortune.

The man plans to reward himself with a dream vacation to Europe, calling the win “life-changing.” He’s already considering where to travel. For now, the thrill of holding a $15 million ticket is enough.

Seraglio Lotto, where the ticket was sold, shared in the excitement. Store owner Amelia Lay expressed her joy, stating, “We love making dreams come true, and we did it again! Our local community is over the moon for the winner, and we can’t wait to do it again soon.”

The winning numbers in Oz Lotto draw 1594 were 43, 35, 9, 38, 32, 8, and 3, with supplementary numbers 33, 22, and 46. There were two division one winning entries in this draw—one in Victoria and one in New South Wales.

16 Oz Lotto division one winners across Australia have collectively won more than $323 million this year, including a $90 million jackpot shared by three winners.

The future is filled with endless possibilities for this newly minted millionaire from Glen Waverley—starting with a well-deserved European getaway!
